title: [finding] cli(console mount): with no Console built, /_console/ and / answer an anonymous 404 instead of saying the Console is not built and how to build it; and os serve --help's --ui flag still names @object-ui/console
body:
Filing gate: ① a product defect, reproduced. This card carries the half of #22155 that triage routed away from `domain:devx`, plus one same-family help string found while fixing the other half.
- reach: public doors, measured.
  - `GET /_console/` and `GET /` on a server with no Console answer a bare 404 (measured in #22155's body).
  - `os serve --help` prints the `--ui` text below (measured on the built CLI at PR #22224's head `0ef75bd7d9`).

This card carries #22155's **HTTP half**, which #22155's own reader line routes to `domain:cli`. PR #22224 (the `domain:devx` bundle #22155 + #22164) carries the README step and the boot warning's remedy, and closes #22155 when it merges.

Filed by PM seat `domain:devx#2` (`session_01VF48aw8RPG6wzDnMgp6rtw`), so that the half has a card after #22155 closes. ⛔ Not graded or routed here. ⛔ Not a claim.

**Reader:** triage first-touch → `domain:cli`, the lane of the Console mount in `packages/cli/src/commands/serve.ts`.

## What is measured

1. **The absence is not loud at the HTTP surface.** This is #22155's body, verbatim measurement: a fresh clone of `main`, `pnpm install && pnpm build && pnpm dev`, and no `packages/console/dist`.
   - `GET /_console/` returns `404` with `{"success":false,"error":{"code":"ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND","message":"Not found"}}`.
   - `GET /` returns `404` with an empty body.
   - Both are indistinguishable from a wrong URL. AGENTS.md's "Absence must be loud" rule asks a composition that legitimately serves nothing to say so once, naming the remedy.
   - After PR #22224 the terminal names the right remedy. The HTTP answers are unchanged: the dev measured `/_console/` → 404 on a live boot at `0ef75bd7d9`.
2. **The `--ui` help text names a package the resolver never reads.**
   - `packages/cli/src/commands/serve.ts:1198` prints `--[no-]ui  Enable the bundled Console portal at /_console/ when @object-ui/console is installed`, and `packages/cli/README.md:244` mirrors it.
   - But `resolveConsolePath` (`packages/cli/src/utils/console.ts`) reads only `@objectstack/console`; an installed `@object-ui/console` is never consulted.
   - The comment at `serve.ts:5053` also still calls the mounted Console `@object-ui/console`.

## Done when

- **On a composition with no built Console,** `GET /_console/` answers with a short page or JSON saying the Console is not built and naming the remedy. That is the same remedy the boot warning now picks (`formatConsoleDistMissingWarning` in `packages/cli/src/utils/console.ts`, from PR #22224); reuse it, ⛔ no second remedy picker.
- **`GET /`** either does the same or redirects to it. Which one is this card's choice, stated in the PR.
- **The `--ui` help text, `packages/cli/README.md:244` and the `serve.ts:5053` comment** name `@objectstack/console`.
- **Tests pin both HTTP answers,** each with a positive control: with a built Console, the SPA is served.

## Dedupe

REST listings of issues updated since 2026-09-01 and since 2026-10-01 (`state=all`, union 2,007), grepped for `_console/…404|ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND…console|console not built|--[no-]ui|object-ui/console installed`:
- 6 hits;
- the only one on point is #22155 itself, the parent of this half;
- the others are QA run records #21318 and #21330, #22079 (public-form slugs) and #22202 (`--no-server` schema).
